prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production-ready transparent 2D action game VFX sprite atlas, 8 separate sprites, exactly 4 columns by 2 rows.
Primary request: Create a lavish hand-painted dark-fantasy projectile effects atlas for two heroes in a gothic side-scrolling action RPG. Use the two supplied images only as STYLE and MATERIAL references, not edit targets. Image 1 is gold-white branching lightning; image 2 is black-violet spectral blade energy. Do not reproduce their old layout.
Canvas/layout: wide 1536 by 1024 RGBA PNG, genuinely transparent background. Eight equal imaginary cells 384 by 512. NO grid lines or borders. Place one isolated effect in the center of each cell, leave generous fully transparent margins so every sprite can be cropped independently without clipping or touching any neighbor. Keep each effect within its own cell with at least 28 pixels clear on all sides. Every moving effect travels LEFT TO RIGHT. Clean silhouettes readable when displayed only 70-130 pixels wide, detailed painterly materials inside.
Top row: gold-white thunder fist shock projectiles, elegant silver-blue secondary forks.
Cell 1: launch discharge, a tight source spark left-of-center, a forward burst of curved branching lightning that forms the impression of a supernatural punch without a literal hand or gauntlet.
Cell 2: in-flight thunder pulse A, compact right-pointing lightning spearhead made of wild branching arcs wrapping a bright tapered core, trailing sparks curl to the left.
Cell 3: in-flight thunder pulse B, same scale and direction and center as cell 2, slightly changed forks and core pulse, logical animation continuation.
Cell 4: impact, a compact fierce white-gold electrical shatter with sharp branching arcs, bright central contact point, short flying embers. Spectacular but bounded.
Bottom row: shadow rogue spectral throwing blades, black feather smoke, sharp violet-silver crescent edges.
Cell 1: launch slash, paired short silver-violet dagger-shaped crescents thrust to the right, black raven-feather wisps peel left, source near left-of-center.
Cell 2: flying paired crescent blades A, two clear offset hooked dagger silhouettes pointing right, cold silver cutting edges and violet plasma, smoky black feather trail left.
Cell 3: flying paired crescent blades B, same scale/center/direction as cell 2, slightly rotating blades and altered wisps for a coherent flight loop.
Cell 4: impact, crossed crescent dagger cuts and a compact violet-silver shattering burst, several black spectral feathers, no huge magic circle.
Materials/style: premium illustrated game spell effects, controlled luminous cores, layered painterly filaments and jagged crystal edges, restrained bloom, energetic asymmetry, sharp readable shapes, matching a mature gothic fantasy environment.
Constraints: Effects ONLY. No people, faces, limbs, fists, weapons held by characters, UI icons, labels, lettering, frame numbers, arrows, scenery, floors, black rectangles, checkerboard pattern or opaque haze. Preserve real alpha transparency outside effects and in gaps. No long straight laser beam. No orange fire on thunder row. No giant circles that obscure the character. No adjacent sprites touching.
